General Ledger Summary

The General Ledger Summary form configures parameters for account balance reports.

Set date ranges to analyze general ledger account movements and balances.

Description

Enter an optional description for this report.

From

Enter the start date for the summary period.

To

Enter the end date for the summary period.

Show account codes

Check this box to display account codes alongside account names.

Exclude zero balances

Check this box to hide accounts with zero movement and balance.
